invariant: A character that a measured face's cmap maps is measured with that face's own advance. A character the face does not map keeps the current fallback chain.
causal_divergence: Verdana, Arial and Helvetica own-closures cover printable ASCII only, so mapped non-ASCII characters fall through to SansSerif. The known gaps are Verdana italic «Ferrous gauge vista» (Java 157.2197), «marker» (Java 61.2366) and Latin+Hebrew m9a_vi_hebrew_italic.
planned_change: After the Monkey Man cmap extraction returns and its scalars match the round-9 P runs and font hashes, replace the ASCII-only own closure for Helvetica, Arial and Verdana and delete the retained 1139-unit guillemet arm. Do not invent advances before that extraction.
